queries.name: hot only, last hour, count
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

queries.name: merge, service opentelemetry-collector and one day, both in the path
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE ServiceName = 'opentelemetry-collector' AND day = '2026-09-10'

queries.name: merge, service opentelemetry-collector, no day predicate
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE ServiceName = 'opentelemetry-collector'

queries.name: merge, time only, the shape HyperDX sends
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

queries.name: merge, time plus day >= today() - 1
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND day >= today() - 1

queries.name: merge, text search for 'snapshot', no other filter
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'snapshot') > 0

queries.name: merge, text search for 'snapshot', one day
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'snapshot') > 0 AND day = '2026-09-10'

queries.name: merge, one pattern hash, no time filter
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE LogAttributes['tenx_hash'] = 'z1LKaIvhNlY'

queries.name: merge, one pattern hash and one day
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE LogAttributes['tenx_hash'] = 'z1LKaIvhNlY' AND day = '2026-09-10'

queries.name: cold only, one day, count
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_cold30v WHERE day = '2026-09-10'
